title: Kinetic type, full screen
description: Three to five words take the whole screen one after another, each sized to fill the frame width (mask rise, wipe, weight and tracking change, drop; GSAP timeline), then all of them settle into one lockup of lines with different sizes and one word turns gold. About three seconds, no clicks. On a phone the lockup becomes a tall poster.

props.words: required, 3-5 short words (one or two syllables read best)
props.gold: the word that ends gold: the word itself or its number counted from 1 (default: the last)
props.kicker: small caps in the top corner
